name: Lozoya (Spain)
description: White field with three blue wavy horizontal stripes, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Lozoya (wavy stripes on white and scallop shells on blue).
history: Lozoya adopted its arms and flag officially on 26 April 2004, published in the Boletín Oficial de la Comunidad de Madrid on 31 May 2005; the flag is a rectangular cloth of proportions 2:3, white, with three blue wavy fesses and the arms of the town at the centre.
